answer: Bind each identity to one live paying client contract, verified through its payment flow, with 50 units locked as escrow until one clean epoch ends. One fake costs one real client plus 50 units; ten fakes cost ten distinct clients and 500 units, so cost scales linearly in money and harder in client acquisition. A forged or shared client cancels both identities and burns both escrows. The vertex, forge and tide contract checks run every epoch, and any failed check forfeits the escrow.
